decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship cloud messaging offer and a close fit with its strategic direction, it has strong option value and little indication so far that abandoning it would be justified.
The service extends the firm's document workflow capabilities and already shows reference-customer traction, so the uncertainty is resolving positively and supports continued commercialization.

This conversion service sits near the firm's established secure messaging and fax base, and its likely modest carrying cost makes it worth keeping open despite limited visible evidence of standout success.
Although fax is a mature niche, this optimization feature strengthens an existing core communication channel and is likely inexpensive to maintain, so keeping the option open is still reasonable.

With no clear proof of market traction, ongoing security-maintenance demands, and evidence that the firm already pruned a related email security product, reallocating resources away from this weaker option is the more likely choice.
